Tommy Gun Marionettes

A downloadable game for Windows

*In Production - Demo Available!*

The witches are killing again, harvesting organs from the dead. Special Agent Bram works the backstreets, chasing the witches as the bodies fall. Tommy Gun Marionettes is a retro pixel-art, point-and-click noir adventure set in a world of witches, octofolk, pigfolk, and people who'd rather he stopped asking questions.

Game features

• Gritty, colorful urban pixel art.

• Play as a dry-witted detective of the Arcane Unit.

• Chase down the witches and foil their plans.

• Confront killing klowns (yeah, klowns!).

• Prowl the city's backstreets, bars, and teacup ride.

• Deal with octofolk and pigfolk.

• Point and click puzzles & item inventory.

• A spiritual successor to Tommy Gun Witches!


Release date: Q3 2027

Some cartoonish, pixelated depictions of gore and dead bodies.
